System Requirements Function Description

1. Front-end Function
Film and TV Information Browsing: Users can browse the latest movie and TV series information
Film and TV Reviews: Users can comment on movies and TV series
Film and TV Sharing: Users can share their favorite movies and TV series
Film and TV Rankings: Users can view the most popular movie and TV series rankings
Film and TV Search: Users can search for movies and TV series of interest by keywords
Crew Information Query: Users can query the crew information of movies and TV series, such as directors, actors, etc.
User Login: Users can register and log in to the website to enjoy more personalized services
Crew Login: Crew members can register and log in to the website to publish and manage relevant information
User Registration: Users can register to become website members
Crew Registration: Crew members can register to become website members

2. Backstage functions
General user management: Administrators can manage the account information of registered users, such as adding, deleting, and modifying user information
Crew information management: Administrators can manage the account information of registered crews, such as adding, deleting, and modifying crew information
Administrator information management: Administrators can manage their own account information, such as changing passwords, viewing logs, etc.
News information management: Administrators can publish, edit, and delete news information
News column management: Administrators can add, delete, and modify news columns
Film and television information publishing management: Administrators can publish, edit, and delete information about movies and TV series
Comment information management: Administrators can view, review, and delete user comment information
Film and television ranking management: Administrators can adjust the ranking rules for movies and TV series
System maintenance: Administrators can perform basic system maintenance, such as backing up the database, updating the system, etc.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0246
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` char(255) NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('user','crew') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `crews` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` char(255) NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('crew') NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `movies` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `release_year` int(4) NOT NULL,
  `genre` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tv_series` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `release_year` int(4) NOT NULL,
  `genre` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `movie_comments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `movie_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `movie_id` (`movie_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `movie_comments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`movie_id`) REFERENCES `movies` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `movie_comments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tv_comments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tv_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `tv_id` (`tv_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tv_comments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tv_id`) REFERENCES `tv_series` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `tv_comments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `movie_ratings` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `movie_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `rating` tinyint(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `movie_id` (`movie_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `movie_ratings_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`movie_id`) REFERENCES `movies` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `movie_ratings_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tv_ratings` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tv_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `rating` tinyint(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `tv_id` (`tv_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tv_ratings_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tv_id`) REFERENCES `tv_series` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `tv_ratings_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `news` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `author` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `news_categories` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `news_news_categories` (
  `news_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `category_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`news_id`, `category_id`),
  KEY `news_id` (`news_id`),
  KEY `category_id` (`category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `news_news_categories_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`news_id`) REFERENCES `news` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `news_news_categories_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `news_categories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `movie_genres` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `movie_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `genre` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `movie_id` (`movie_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `movie_genres_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`movie_id`) REFERENCES `movies` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tv_genres` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tv_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `genre` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `tv_id` (`tv_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tv_genres_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tv_id`) REFERENCES `tv_series` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
